```yaml
name: Test FATFS Support

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential git libssl-dev zlib1g-dev libncurses5-dev libncursesw5-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev libgdbm-dev libdb5.3-dev libbz2-dev libexpat1-dev liblzma-dev tk-dev libffi-dev

    - name: Create FATFS image file
      run: |
        dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
        mkfs.vfat fatfs.img

    - name: Create test file
      run: echo "Hello, FATFS!" > testfile.txt

    - name: Mount FATFS image
      run: sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs

    - name: Copy test file to FATFS image
      run: cp testfile.txt /mnt/fatfs/

    - name: Unmount FATFS image
      run: sudo umount /mnt/fatfs

    - name: Compile wolfSSH with FATFS support
      run: |
        ./configure --enable-fatsupport
        make

    - name: Run wolfSFTP client to get test file
      run: |
        sftp localhost:/mnt/fatfs/testfile.txt localtestfile.txt

    - name: Verify file exists in FATFS image
      run: ls /mnt/fatfs/testfile.txt

    - name: Verify file contents match original file
      run: diff testfile.txt localtestfile.txt

    - name: Teardown
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
      with:
        skip-wait-ssh: true
```
